answer_1.quote: We evaluate our proposed framework on two tasks: argument generation and story generation. ... Our RST controlled text generation framework can be built upon any pretrained language model.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form argumentative texts and narrative stories generated with controllable RST structures.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU focusing on the n‑gram precision; Distinct‑n, which takes the proportion of distinct n‑grams relative to all generated n‑grams; the GRUEN Structure and Coherence metric (G‑SC); and MS‑Jaccard ... We also report BLEU, METEOR in earlier evaluations.
